note_add: Iowa charges no state park entrance fee; the 2019-2025 non-resident vehicle-fee pilot at Lake Manawa (and Waubonsie) ended January 1, 2026, and registered campers were exempt from it anyway. Reservation fee $4.50 online, $6 by phone, per site reserved; change $5 online / $6.50 phone, cancellation $6 / $7. Rates include sales tax (camping only; cabins and lodges are taxed on top). A $4-5/night fee applies to holiday-weekend stays (Memorial Day, Fourth of July, Labor Day) and some special-event fees may apply. No more than six people a site, except an immediate family that cannot be split across two sites. Each camping unit may park one non-camping vehicle at its site, some parks a second (posted at the campground); no charge for it is published.

note_add: From January 1, 2027 the reservation processing fee is $10 per reservation (it was $5 per site through 2026; the reservation system was paused Sept. 1 - Dec. 31, 2026 for the change). The 2027 schedule adds a $10 holiday fee (Fri-Sun nights of Memorial Day and Labor Day weekends, and of July 4th weekend when the 4th falls Fri-Mon) to Premium Electric and Electric sites and cabins, not to non-electric sites. Illinois charges no park entry fee. Non-residents pay the base rate; the discounts are for Illinois residents only. Neither fee schedule charges for people or vehicles on a family site, but the rules cap them: a family is parents and unmarried children plus others in the same shelter up to 4 adults, a non-family group 4 people; a motorhome site may add one car (or a car and two motorcycles), a trailer site two vehicles. Tax treatment is not stated.
